query:
UPDATE roles
            SET deleted_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1
              AND tenant_id = $2
              AND deleted_at IS NULL
              AND is_system = FALSE
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM users
                  WHERE users.tenant_id = $2
                    AND roles.key = ANY(users.roles)
                    AND users.deleted_at IS NULL
              )
